title: Hosted API pilot — rate limits, endpoints, and quickstart next steps
text:
Hosted API pilot — rate limits, endpoints, and quickstart next steps

["From: Alice Park <alice@lumiretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@lumiretail.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up from today — pilot scope and rate question

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Mina. Really helpful to see the hosted API flow and the console. A couple quick items we want to lock down before the internal kickoff: 

- We plan to start with a 6-week pilot using the hosted API (not dedicated) unless you advise otherwise.
- Approx expected traffic for the pilot: 50k API calls/week, typical request ~120 tokens in/out, peak bursts up to 12 requests/sec during storefront events.
- Two ops questions: what are the default per-minute rate limits and concurrent connection limits for the hosted trial? Can those be temporarily increased for the pilot window?

I've attached a rough pilot scope spreadsheet (lumi_pilot_scope.xlsx). Also copying our DevOps to confirm there are no network restrictions.

Next steps for us: we want a short written checklist of what Redwood needs from our side to begin (API keys, IP allowlist, sample dataset if needed). Can you send that over?

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Product — LumiRetail
alice@lumiretail.com

---
Attachment: lumi_pilot_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)", 'From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@lumiretail.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@lumiretail.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today — pilot scope and rate question

Hi Alice — great meeting, thank you. Recapping and adding the immediate next steps so we have a shared checklist: 

1) Deployment mode: Hosted API pilot confirmed. That’s the fastest path for a 6-week evaluation. If your sustained QPS grows above ~200 requests/sec we should revisit Dedicated.

2) Default rate limits (hosted trial): 3,600 requests per hour per API key (equivalent to ~1 RPS sustained) and a soft concurrency limit of 10 concurrent streaming connections. For pilots we can raise the hourly cap and concurrency for short bursts — please provide expected peak windows/dates and an internal contact to approve adjustments.

3) Endpoints: Sandbox base URL will be https://api.redwood.ai/v1 (you’ll get API key + sandbox route). Main endpoints we expect you to use: /v1/generate (batch text generation), /v1/chat (stateful chat with kv-cache), and streaming via SSE for storefront latency-sensitive flows.

4) Security & onboarding items we need from you: basic contact for onboarding, IP ranges if you require allowlisting, and whether any requests include PII or regulated data (if yes, we’ll map retention/processing options).

5) Docs & artifacts: I’m attaching a short pilot SOW draft and a quickstart checklist. We’ll also share a one-page runbook for bursting rate increases.

Proposed next actions: 
- You: confirm peak burst windows and whether the DevOps team requires IP allowlist.
- Us: provision sandbox API key, share Hosted Quickstart doc, propose a kickoff time for Wed 2027-01-27 morning PT.

I’ll loop in Rishi for any deeper rate-limit/throughput questions.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: redwood_pilot_sow_draft.pdf (PDF, 78 KB), redwood-quickstart-checklist.md (text, 6 KB)', 'From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice@lumiretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today — pilot scope and rate question

On Mon, Jan 25, 2027 at 5:03 PM Mina Haddad wrote:
> 2) Default rate limits (hosted trial): 3,600 requests per hour per API key (equivalent to ~1 RPS sustained) and a soft concurrency limit of 10 concurrent streaming connections. For pilots we can raise the hourly cap and concurrency for short bursts — please provide expected peak windows/dates and an internal contact to approve adjustments.

Hi team — quick technical clarifications from the infra side: 

- For the hosted pilot we typically set token-based quotas (tokens/min) rather than raw request counts for better alignment to cost and throughput. With the profile Alice shared (avg 120 tokens), the default quota maps to ~30k tokens/hour. We can bump that to 100k tokens/hour for the first two weeks to cover bursts.
- Concurrency: streaming channels are multiplexed; we can support short bursts up to ~50 concurrent streams for pilots if notified in advance. Sustained >200 concurrent streams is a Dedicated-level discussion.
- Endpoint notes: use /v1/chat for interactive session flows to leverage KV cache; /v1/generate is more cost-efficient for stateless batched generation. Streaming SSE will reduce perceived latency but consumes a connection slot.
- Operationally: if you expect scheduled events (promotions) where traffic spikes for 10–45 minutes, list those windows now and we’ll provision temporary rate-ins increases tied to that schedule.

I’m happy to join the kickoff to walk through the runbook and confirm how we’ll handle any spike-day increases.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today — pilot scope and rate question

Thanks — that all looks good. Confirming: we’ll proceed with the Hosted API pilot and accept the bumped token quota for the first two weeks (100k tokens/hour) and temporary concurrency increases for planned storefront events. Our initial schedule: kickoff Wed 2027-01-27 at 11:00 PT, pilot start Mon 2027-02-01.

Action items for us:
- DevOps to send any IP ranges for allowlist by EOD Friday.
- Product to share a short sample of anonymized request payloads (2–3 examples) so you can pre-warm model caches.
- Legal to review SOW draft — we’ll send redlines if any.

Security ask: we need a SOC 2 attestation and a short note on data retention policies for hosted evaluations (what data is logged and retention windows). Can you attach the security questionnaire we mentioned?

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — see you on the kickoff.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Product — LumiRetail
